Üretilmiş zebra fotoğrafı, hesaplama içi: The generated zebra photo is converted to a 32 × 32 grayscale matrix for computation.
3 × 3 filtre soldan sağa, satır satır ge: A 3 × 3 filter moves left to right, row by row. Products are summed; ReLU sets negative results to zero.
2 × 2 bölgedeki en büyük değer alınır. S: The largest value in each 2 × 2 region is selected. A stride of 2 reduces the map size.
Küçülen haritalara aynı üç örnek filtre: The same three example filters are applied again to the smaller maps.
En güçlü değerler korunur; uzamsal boyut: The strongest values are retained; spatial dimensions shrink again.
Son filtre geçişi daha küçük özellik har: The final filter pass produces smaller feature maps.
The final pooling reduces each map to 2 × 2.
Üç haritadaki 12 değer, sırası korunarak: The 12 values from three maps are flattened into one vector, preserving their order.
12 değer, örnek ağırlıklarla 6 nörona ba: 12 values connect to 6 neurons using example weights. These weights have not been trained.
Örnek çıkış skorları, toplamı 1 olan değ: Example output scores are converted to values summing to 1. They are not animal recognition probabilities.
Eğitim gösterimi: filtreler sabittir, ağ: Educational demonstration: filters are fixed and the network is untrained. Convolution, ReLU, pooling, flatten and Softmax with example weights are actually computed; A/B/C scores do not represent an animal classifier.

Kesikli çizgi değişmeyen tonu, renkli eğ: The dashed line is identity; the colored curve shows the transformation. Computation uses normalized values; the 8-bit result is rounded.
Gama 1 tonu korur; 1’den küçük değer ort: Gamma 1 preserves tones; values below 1 brighten midtones and above 1 darken them.
Log dönüşümü koyu tonları açar. a=255 iç: Log transformation brightens dark tones. For a=255, s=255·ln(1+r)/ln256. At a=0, identity is used.

Tamamladığın bölümler burada birikir. Ye: Completed levels collect here. Starting a new journey keeps your collection; free mode does not count.
RGB seçilince üç kanal birlikte büyür. R: RGB increases all three channels together. R, G or B increases only that channel; the others stay at 1.
WASD, ok tuşları veya kaydırmayla yön ve: Use WASD, arrow keys or swipes to move; the game starts automatically. Space pauses. Your selected color channel increases when you complete a level.
Piksel değerleri değişmeden kalır. Diğer: Pixel values remain unchanged. This is the baseline for comparing other transformations.
Üstel dönüşüm orta tonları değiştirir. γ: The power transform changes midtones. γ=1 is the identity; γ<1 brightens and γ>1 darkens.
Logaritma yüksek değerleri sıkıştırırken: The logarithm compresses high values and can reveal differences in dark tones. The special case a=0 uses s=r.
İki sınır arasındaki ton aralığı genişle: The tonal range between two limits is expanded. The studio mixes the original and stretched values using contrast fraction α; the result is clipped to 0–255.
Her kanalda açık ve koyu değerler tersin: Light and dark values are reversed in each channel. Applying the transform twice restores the original value.
Renk kanallarından ağırlıklı parlaklık h: Weighted luminance is calculated from the color channels. Grayscale amount α mixes the color and grayscale results.
Eşikleme, parlaklığı yalnız iki sınıfa a: Thresholding divides luminance into just two classes. Changing the threshold moves the class boundary.
Kanallar ayrı katsayılarla çarpılır. Yal: Each channel is multiplied by its own factor. Show only sets the other channels to zero.
Ton çevrimseldir; doygunluk ve parlaklık: Hue is cyclic; saturation and value are scaled and limited to their valid ranges. The result is converted back to RGB.
Belirli yoğunluk aralığı seçilir. Maske: A specified intensity range is selected. Masking makes other regions black; highlighting preserves them.
Komşuluk sıralanır, ortadaki değer seçil: The neighborhood is sorted and the middle value is selected. It can reduce isolated extreme values; it is not a linear average.
3×3 komşuluğun bütün pikselleri eşit ağı: All pixels in the 3×3 neighborhood have equal weights. It can blur edges while smoothing noise.
Stüdyonun 3×3 filtresinde yakın komşular: In the studio’s 3×3 filter, closer neighbors have greater weights. The coefficients sum to 1.
Gri seviye genişletme yerel maksimumu se: Grayscale dilation selects the local maximum, expanding bright regions. It is applied separately to each channel of a color image.
Bu araç gri seviye aşındırmadır; yerel m: This tool is grayscale erosion: the local minimum shrinks bright regions. It is not a topological skeletonization algorithm.
Stüdyonun renk maskesi dairesel ton uzak: The studio color mask uses circular hue distance. Tap selection uses connectivity and color distance; the object model predicts a learned mask. These are three different methods, not one formula.
Tek formül yerine ölçümlerden ayar seçen: Rules choose settings from measurements rather than using one formula. Gamma, contrast, color balance and, when needed, median filtering can be combined.
Stüdyo ilk dolu seviyenin kümülatif payı: The studio subtracts the cumulative share at the first occupied level. The quiz example round(7·CDF) defines a different mapping, so results need not match. The transform is skipped when a constant image makes the denominator zero.
